definitions.full: H580. anu אֲנוּ Jer 42:6 Kt: see after אֲנִי . אֲנוּ pronoun 1 plural common we (common in Post-Biblical Hebrew; compare also Amharic §ñ¹ ) may be regarded as the plural of אֲנִי (W SG 99 ), only Jer 42:6 Kt, for which Qr substitutes the normal אֲנַחְנוּ .
